interpretation: Correct IR improves this held-program aggregate over the specified controls, particularly source/target availability and damage. This is narrow single-seed native-fixture evidence, not a blanket semantic-success claim.
Joint-held cost is essentially tied with context-only; ready/exhaust delta and zero Shield/XP/terminal heads do not uniformly improve.
All joint heads have diagnostic-only low-support flags. The two held programs select disjoint target domains; no jointly committed same-candidate delta pairs exist between those two alone.
Nonzero typed/numeric gradients and damage/ready/availability predictions show connected/useful paths under this objective, not calibrated semantic distances or strategic preservation.
